environment.description: Service runs on ECS Fargate tasks in private subnets (10.0.128.0/18, 10.0.192.0/18) with no NAT gateway and no internet gateway attached to the VPC route table. Exposed exclusively through an AWS PrivateLink interface endpoint service (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890). The endpoint service has 'Acceptance Required' enabled, meaning only pre-approved AWS accounts can create interface endpoints to reach it. The VPC has no peering connections, no Transit Gateway attachments, and no VPN connections. Security groups on the Fargate ENIs restrict ingress to the VPC CIDR only (10.0.0.0/16) on port 8080. DNS resolution for the service is only available via the VPC endpoint's private DNS name. There is no public DNS record pointing to this service.
